full_judgment: 19. The plaintiff then, inspite of his having knowledge of his father's sale to Md Younus Talukder on 13-2-2009, has filed this instant frivolous, vexatious and ill-advised suit, and interestingly, tried to expose himself as an scholar about the formalities required to be performed for filing a pre-emption case under the provisions of Muhammadan Law, a practice which has almost lost into oblivion, since the pre-emption cases are now being filed, either under section 96 of the SAT Act, 1950 or under section 24 of the NAT Act, 1949.
